implementation_constraints: two units: source/model.py (pure) + source/cli.py (entry, imports model); run python cli.py from source/

unresolved_intent.decision: Accounts in balances dict ordered by insertion order (order of first appearance in accepted postings)
unresolved_intent.rationale: Spec does not mandate account ordering. Python 3.7+ dicts preserve insertion order; this natural order reflects the sequence accounts are first seen.

unresolved_intent.decision: Empty lines array treated as shape-valid structure, passed to model for logical rejection (insufficient lines rule)
unresolved_intent.rationale: Spec explicitly distinguishes shape errors (structural JSON validity) from logical rejections (business rules). Empty array is structurally valid JSON but fails ≥2 lines requirement.

unresolved_intent.decision: JSON output formatted via json.dumps() with default settings (no pretty-print, no key sorting)
unresolved_intent.rationale: Spec states only structure and values are fixed, not formatting. Using standard json.dumps behavior.

unresolved_intent.decision: Duplicate id detection via set membership; rejected list maintains input order via sequential append
unresolved_intent.rationale: Spec requires rejected list in input order. Set provides O(1) duplicate detection; list append preserves order. Alternative approaches (linear scan) would be O(n) per posting.

compilation_report.constraint_handling: first multi-unit bench archetype; the seam ADR-001 is in the canonical package (ADR-029)
